1.

Saviour, take my hand, Train me so, That in Thy footsteps I may ever walk! Lord, for each day Draw me to Thy heart, That in Thy truth I Might firmly stand!

2.

The Rock, which was smitten for me, Gives me water, Manna for each day Still falls down. Jesus bears my care, Ever He has me dear, Yea, in all things here Love I see.

3.

Jesus, in Thy footsteps I will follow. Keep me in joy and need Only with Thee still! What more can I desire? Thou, who seest the need, All that I lack, givest, More besides!
